component_interpretation: The hosted marker proves natural helper progress after the first exclusive FD is released, between admission attempts. It is not a separately measured fresh tick after the final upgrade lease is released. Cleared holds/upgrade after final release were independently checked.
limits: Customer output is consistent with a live launch handoff; the exact instantaneous customer failure was not traced or independently reproduced on that VPS.
A guarded source candidate was atomically overlaid on the disposable fixture and normal compatibility commands established real readiness. This is NOT normal/public installer provisioning acceptance.

The deterministic native component retained an already owned real exclusive FD in its FIRST acquisition callback until a real cron helper was active/unstarted; later acquisitions and every prepare/reconcile/DB/ownership/upgrade step use production code. No invocation, nonce, ACK, seal or service definition was fabricated.

Exact public AMD64 CLI READY/release used the actual signed release bytes and actual parent/lifecycle path, but did not exercise a pending launch in that public binary run. The pending path is independently source/component qualified.
No new full normal public upgrade, actual public daemon replacement, native ARM64/Cronie, real Laravel-framework, PHP/Node apply, Reverb or ACME execution acceptance is claimed.

Historical, malformed, joined/multiple errors, real maintenance and unresolved launches retain refusal. Only current unconsumed bootstrap authority is eligible for bounded waiting; no authority is marked started or discarded.
Experimental off main/latest. Qualified base handoff remains stable053 until separately verified final stable054 identities. Old immutable assets are unchanged.
